canonical_project: North Bavarian High-Performance Computing Center at FAU / NHR@FAU new building
owner: Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg; Free State of Bavaria
notes: FAU reported construction started at Campus Erlangen South for the Erlangen National High-Performance Computing Center, after more than EUR270m funding approval. FAU campus-development materials describe a new high-performance computing center with computing and office modules; DCD reports the expansion will provide 10 MW for northern Bavarian universities.
